question: If one knower of kula scripture is present, is he alone worthy of worship there?
premises: one knower of kula scripture suffices
inference: A single kula-scripture knower present in that place is certainly worthy of worship.
uncertainties: sandhi fusion in ekaścet and pūjārhastatra is resolved by editor
plain_english: If even one knower of the kula scripture is present there, he is certainly worthy of worship.
